chunks.title: engram 的现代定义
chunks.sourceText: The review frames engram neurons as populations of cells that are activated during learning, undergo lasting changes, and can contribute to memory retrieval when reactivated.

blocks.text: The review frames engram neurons as populations of cells that are activated during learning, undergo lasting changes, and can contribute to memory retrieval when reactivated.

chunks.zhTranslation: 这篇综述把 engram neurons 定义为在学习期间被激活、发生持久改变，并在重新激活时能参与记忆提取的细胞群。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这让“记忆痕迹”从抽象概念变成可操作研究对象，但仍不能直接映射成软件数据库条目。

chunks.title: 细胞集合而非单个位置
chunks.sourceText: An engram is not simply a single storage location. It is better understood as a distributed and dynamic ensemble whose members and accessibility can change across time and brain regions.

blocks.text: An engram is not simply a single storage location. It is better understood as a distributed and dynamic ensemble whose members and accessibility can change across time and brain regions.

chunks.zhTranslation: engram 不是一个单一存储位置。它更适合被理解为分布式、动态的细胞集合，其成员和可访问性会随时间和脑区变化。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这对应 agent memory 的一个重要提醒：记忆不是写入后永远固定，索引、权重和可检索性都可能变化。

chunks.title: 编码与分配
chunks.sourceText: During encoding, only a subset of neurons becomes part of a memory ensemble. Excitability, activity history, and local competition can influence which neurons are allocated to an engram.

blocks.text: During encoding, only a subset of neurons becomes part of a memory ensemble. Excitability, activity history, and local competition can influence which neurons are allocated to an engram.

chunks.zhTranslation: 在编码期间，只有一部分神经元会成为某个记忆集合的一部分。兴奋性、活动历史和局部竞争会影响哪些神经元被分配进 engram。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这可以转译成 agent 写入策略：不是所有经验都同等进入长期记忆，写入资格本身需要规则。

chunks.title: 写入不是只存内容
chunks.sourceText: Engram formation involves changes that make a later cue capable of reactivating the ensemble. The important variable is not only content storage but also the future ability to access the trace.

blocks.text: Engram formation involves changes that make a later cue capable of reactivating the ensemble. The important variable is not only content storage but also the future ability to access the trace.

chunks.zhTranslation: engram 形成涉及一些改变，使得后续线索能够重新激活该集合。关键变量不只是内容存储，还包括未来访问该痕迹的能力。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这对阅读器搜索也有启发：chunk 不只是文本，还要有关键词、向量和图示引用来增加可访问性。

chunks.title: 巩固改变分布
chunks.sourceText: Consolidation can stabilize memory traces and change their dependence on particular circuits. Cellular changes and systems-level redistribution both matter for how a memory persists over time.

blocks.text: Consolidation can stabilize memory traces and change their dependence on particular circuits. Cellular changes and systems-level redistribution both matter for how a memory persists over time.

chunks.zhTranslation: 巩固可以稳定记忆痕迹，并改变它们对特定环路的依赖。细胞变化和系统层面的重新分布都影响记忆如何跨时间保持。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这把 CLS 和 engram 联系起来：一个是计算层解释，一个是细胞和系统层证据语言。

chunks.title: 提取是重新激活
chunks.sourceText: Retrieval can be understood as cue-driven reactivation of an engram ensemble. Successful recall depends on whether the cue can access the relevant ensemble and whether competing traces are controlled.

blocks.text: Retrieval can be understood as cue-driven reactivation of an engram ensemble. Successful recall depends on whether the cue can access the relevant ensemble and whether competing traces are controlled.

chunks.zhTranslation: 提取可以理解为由线索驱动的 engram 集合重新激活。成功回忆取决于线索能否访问相关集合，以及竞争痕迹是否得到控制。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这和 pattern completion / separation 连接很强：线索既要补全目标记忆，也要避免相似记忆干扰。

chunks.title: 光遗传学带来的因果证据
chunks.sourceText: Modern engram research uses techniques such as activity-dependent labeling and optogenetic manipulation to test whether reactivating selected cells can recover or influence memory-related behavior.

blocks.text: Modern engram research uses techniques such as activity-dependent labeling and optogenetic manipulation to test whether reactivating selected cells can recover or influence memory-related behavior.

blocks.caption: Reader-side evidence ladder
rows: Which cells were active during learning
Whether those cells can drive recall-like behavior
Whether access depends on the ensemble

chunks.zhTranslation: 现代 engram 研究使用活动依赖标记和光遗传学操控等技术，测试重新激活特定细胞是否能恢复或影响与记忆相关的行为。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这是证据强度更高的地方：不仅相关，还能通过操控测试因果贡献。

chunks.title: 遗忘可能是访问失败
chunks.sourceText: Forgetting does not always mean that a trace has been erased. A memory can become inaccessible, inhibited, overwritten by interference, or recoverable under the right cue or manipulation.

blocks.text: Forgetting does not always mean that a trace has been erased. A memory can become inaccessible, inhibited, overwritten by interference, or recoverable under the right cue or manipulation.

chunks.zhTranslation: 遗忘并不总是意味着痕迹被擦除。记忆可能变得不可访问、被抑制、受到干扰覆盖，或者在合适线索或操控下可以恢复。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这对 agent memory 非常关键：遗忘可以是删除，也可以是降权、隐藏、隔离或检索阈值提高。

chunks.title: 可访问性函数
chunks.sourceText: A useful abstraction is to separate stored trace strength from retrieval accessibility. A trace can have biological or informational persistence while failing to influence behavior because access is low.

blocks.text: A useful abstraction is to separate stored trace strength from retrieval accessibility. A trace can have biological or informational persistence while failing to influence behavior because access is low.

chunks.zhTranslation: 一个有用的抽象是区分已存痕迹强度和检索可访问性。一个痕迹可以在生物或信息层面仍然存在，但由于访问性低而不能影响行为。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这个公式适合工程转译：记忆是否影响 agent，不只取决于是否存在，还取决于当前检索门控。

chunks.title: 生命周期语言
chunks.sourceText: For agent memory, the engram literature is most useful as a lifecycle model. A memory item should have encoding conditions, consolidation state, retrieval accessibility, update history, and forgetting or suppression rules.

blocks.text: For agent memory, the engram literature is most useful as a lifecycle model. A memory item should have encoding conditions, consolidation state, retrieval accessibility, update history, and forgetting or suppression rules.

chunks.zhTranslation: 对智能体记忆来说，engram 文献最有用的是生命周期模型。一个记忆项应有编码条件、巩固状态、检索可访问性、更新历史，以及遗忘或抑制规则。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这可以成为本项目后续 memory schema 的神经科学主线，不是神经元到向量库的一一映射。
